text: LIVE: Bangladesh General Election 2026: Voters Queue as Polls Open in Historic Vote | AC1ZPolls have opened across Bangladesh as voters line up to cast their ballots in the country’s first general election since the 2024 student-led uprising that toppled long-time leader Sheikh Hasina. Voters were seen queuing outside polling stations in Dhaka early Thursday morning as the nation heads into a crucial and closely watched election. Key political figures, including Jamaat-e-Islami Emir Shafiqur Rahman, BNP leader Tarique Rahman, and Chief Advisor Muhammad Yunus, are scheduled to cast their votes throughout the day. The vote marks a pivotal moment in Bangladesh’s political history, with power, reform, and stability at stake.
